journey.name: Sets of rounds
journey.description: Set two sets of three rounds with a minute between them on the Timer, run the workout through the rest between the sets, and check what the notification says of the set. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Verify that the Timer tab is shown with a "Start workout" button and a "Sets" chip reading "1"
Tap the "Fewer rounds" button until the rounds read "×3"
Tap the "Sets" chip, tap the "2" quick pick and verify that "Between sets" reading "Off" is shown under the quick picks
Tap "More rest between sets" four times and verify that it reads "1:00", then tap "Done"
Verify that the "Sets" chip reads "2 · 1m" and the total reads 5:10
Verify that the workout screen shows "Get ready", then "Work" with "Set 1 of 2 · Round 1 of 3"
Tap "Skip" until the screen shows "Set rest" with "Next: set 2 of 2"
Tap "Skip" and verify that the screen shows "Work" with "Set 2 of 2 · Round 1 of 3"
Press Home and verify that the notification reads "Work · Set 2 of 2 · Round 1 of 3"
Return to the workout, tap "End", then "End workout" in the dialog
Verify that the summary says "Saved to history" and shows 3/6 rounds
Tap "Done", open "All presets" and verify that the unsaved card reads "30s on · 15s off · ×3 · 2 sets · 1m between"
